## About
Paul Ries & Sons is an auto body shop on West Grand in Chicago. Our website calls us the longest-standing auto body repair facility in the Chicagoland area, and we handle everything from bumpers and paint to glass, mechanical work and detailing.
We know nobody plans a trip to a body shop. When it happens, we work with all major insurance companies, keep you updated while your car is with us, and stand behind our workmanship for as long as you own the vehicle. Parts carry the manufacturer's warranty.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 168 reviews. One customer wrote that her car looks like new again, and that is what we aim for every time.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Cosmetic and structural repair after an accident, including bumper and paint work.
- Paintless dent removal: Minor dents and dings taken out without disturbing the original paint finish.
- Glass replacement: Damaged windshields and glass removed and replaced to manufacturer's standards for safety and visibility.
- Mechanical repair: Diagnosis, maintenance and repair for engine, transmission, suspension, brakes and electrical systems.
- Insurance claim process: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider and document repairs to their guidelines.
- Vehicle transport: If your car can't be driven, we bring it to our shop for repairs.
- Detailing: Interior and exterior cleaning, restoration and finishing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair go smoothly.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something comes up, bring the car back and we'll make it right.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on the damage, the repairs needed and parts availability. We'll keep you updated while your car is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Cost depends on the damage, parts, materials and labor. Request an estimate and we'll give you clear pricing.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open weekdays and closed Saturday and Sunday.
